about: Trees and hedges seen on the official aerial photographs (HVBG DOP, compared by eye, 2026-11) where OpenStreetMap has none. World metres (x east, z south). trees: kind wood|group (outline, filled with trees by density dense|medium|sparse = every 6.5|9|13 m, height small|medium|large = 6-10|10-16|15-25 m) or row (a line, a tree every 9 m), broadleaf unless leaf conifer|mixed (a quarter conifers); hedges: line, height_m. Read by tools/mapgen/greenery.ts (docs/MAP_DATA.md). Facts only.
